content: Apple overhauled App Store age ratings in 2025: categories are now 4+, 9+, 13+, 16+, 18+ (dropping old 12+/17+), driven by an expanded content questionnaire in App Store Connect. All apps had to complete the new questionnaire by Jan 31, 2026 or are blocked from new submissions/updates until they do. Family-friendly content with no profanity/gore should land at 4+ or 9+ depending on 'fantasy violence' / 'mild horror themes' answers for a dungeon-crawler with combat and permadeath.
